detailed_description:
Cinematic ancient Chinese night atmosphere, soft moonlight, cool blue palette with warm lantern glow.
[Shot 1] Fixed medium shot, camera locked completely still. The segment opens with <Subject 2> (pink gown, left side) already facing directly toward the camera, lips just closed, her hands still folded at her waist. <Subject 1> (icy-blue gown, right side) stands in profile, looking at <Subject 2>. Over the first 2 seconds, <Subject 1> (S2) slowly turns her head from its profile position toward the camera, her eyes meeting the lens. Simultaneously, her right hand — previously folded at her waist — lifts gently and reaches toward <Subject 2>'s left hand. Their fingers meet and close in a soft hand-hold. <Subject 1> (S2) speaks in a soft, clear female voice, <d>[Chinese] 是啊，难得这样安静。</d> She finishes the line and her lips close naturally. Their hands remain clasped at waist height between them. Mist continues drifting slowly across the floor. Willow branches sway gently. Lantern light flickers subtly.

overall_soundscape:
Night courtyard ambient: soft distant crickets, faint willow rustle, gentle mist whisper. Very faint fabric rustle from the hand-hold movement.

non_diegetic_music:
A slow, ethereal Chinese-style ambient score with faint guzheng arpeggios and sustained low erhu notes, calm and intimate.
